title: JA Kinetic wp7 1.1.8: the theme is listed in WordPress as WP Kinetic
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout read the shipped theme packages/cms/tracy-wordpress-theme/src/wp-ja-kinetic/style.css and its overlay style.css under overlays/wp-ja-kinetic.

S2: Read the release's recorded site sweep tasks/ja-kinetic-wp7/release/fix-measure.json (taken on a clean restore of the 1.0.6 pack against the local Joomla source stand) and tasks/ja-kinetic-wp7/release/SHA256SUMS.
expect: S1: both style.css files read Theme Name: WP Kinetic and the shipped theme is version 1.1.8.
S2: the sweep was taken by site-sweep.mjs on the released theme zip and passes 11 of 11 checks.
evidence: Release of 07/10/2026 against the local Joomla source, theme 1.1.8: full 11-check site-sweep (30/30 routes) on a clean restore of the 1.0.6 pack passed with 0 open groups; wp theme list on the restore shows wp-ja-kinetic titled WP Kinetic at 1.1.8, active
fence: The two style.css headers carry the name and the release's sweep record is the one taken on the shipped zip; the script goes red on the parent of the fix.
